newsitem.title: USA: Key US Senator urges Fed to rethink firewall plan.
newsitem.headline: Key US Senator urges Fed to rethink firewall plan.

text.p: The head of the Senate Banking Committee urged the Federal Reserve on Thursday to reconsider its proposal to eliminate firewalls between commercial banks and their securities affiliates.
"I believe strongly in the need for firewalls and other safeguards," New York Republican Alfonse D'Amato said during a committee hearing on the issue.
The Federal Reserve has proposed lifting many of the longstanding firewalls, which are designed to insulate traditional banking activities from a bank's securities business.
D'Amato called the plan a "mad dash into an area that I think can jeopardize the taxpayers of this country."
